The human consequence of this is that people living on Pacific Islands are watching their homes disappear under the sea. They can only move inland so far before their whole island is flooded. Melissa Neighbor is Media Director of Project Survival Pacific an initiative of the Australian Youth climate coalition to help the people of the Pacific Islands make their voices heard, and deal with the watery doom threatening their way of life. She spoke to Ian Woolf about how to help the people of the Pacific Islands survive the flooding of their homes by the rising seas.
